parameters.name: preferred_language
parameters.description: ISO 639 language; orders returned CGF documents

parameters.name: policy_address
parameters.description: Comma-separated policy_address accounts (min 1, max 64 entries). Returns only Corporations whose policy_address is in the list; an empty value or more than 64 entries is rejected with HTTP 400

parameters.name: modified_after
parameters.description: Only Corporations modified strictly after this ISO 8601 datetime

parameters.name: trust_data
parameters.description: Inline verifiable-trust data per Corporation DID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1..1024 (default 64), per the v4 Pagination spec

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by id ascending or descending

parameters.name: At-Block-Height
parameters.description: Header to query historical state at a specific block height. When provided, returns the state as it was when the specified block finished processing. When omitted, returns the latest indexed state. Must be a positive integer not exceeding the current indexed block height.
